suggestions.issue: Initial Activity controller connection failure only displays a message; this predates the change and is not a new blocking regression.
suggestions.recommendation: Consider bounded reconnect/backoff with future identity checks for this initial failure in a later scoped change. Activity recreation may currently be needed.

suggestions.issue: Inherited Media3 onTaskRemoved also checks for actually playing sessions; isPlaybackOngoing does not guarantee task-dismissal survival during resolving/buffering.
suggestions.recommendation: Keep swiping the task away outside the Home/lock/recreation acceptance guarantee.

suggestions.issue: Source contracts do not execute Android lifecycle/controller/notification behavior.
suggestions.recommendation: Run the documented physical-device acceptance matrix before claiming Home/lock/recreation, notification or latency acceptance.

summary: Independent read-only review of tracked runtime/test diff and all new Kotlin/test files found no evidenced blocking security or introduced logic defects. One service player, generation-checked START/STOP, explicit clipping, paused local restoration/deletion, and public controller metadata with signed source/header RAM containment were reviewed. All 31 selected host contracts and whitespace checks passed. No device execution or Gradle run by reviewer.
review_scope: Runtime Kotlin and related tests; parent release/packaging helpers were outside independent runtime review.
fingerprint_binding: Parent verified app source stayed unchanged across review; fingerprint includes app Kotlin/tests/build/schema/resources, not parent Python packaging helpers.
